prompt: Add a read-only 'doctor' command to scripts/aegis-pilot.ts backed by a new src/aegis/pilot/doctor.ts (export it from src/aegis/pilot/index.ts). Read runbook docs/runbooks/AEGIS_PILOT_RUNBOOK.md §2, §4, §8 and src/aegis/pilot/{identity,evidence-ledger,acceptance}.ts first. doctor --state-dir D [--scope F] prints one JSON document {ok, checks:[{check, ok, detail}]} and exits 0 only if every check passes. Checks, each with the exact name: 'state-dir-mode' (state dir not group/world writable), 'site-key-mode' (site/site.key mode 0600), 'ledger-local-fs' (reuse checkLocalFilesystem from acceptance.ts), 'ledger-verifies' (verifyLedger with the site public key; valid and unsigned===0), 'key-pinned' (only with --scope: scope.site.keyId equals site keyId; missing pin = fail), 'isolation-tool' (unshare available on Linux; warn-only, ok:true with detail on other OS). Never modify state. Add src/__tests__/aegis-pilot-doctor.test.ts (>=6 cases, tmp dirs, no network). Add a doctor step to runbook §4 before the first rehearsal. Ledger segments exist since plan item C2 (src/aegis/pilot/ledger-segments.ts): 'ledger-verifies' must call verifySegments(stateDir, site) and pass only when it is valid, so sealed segments, seals and links are checked too, not only the active file. Do not touch package.json or package-lock.json. prettier --write changed files; commit and push.

checks.name: doctor passes on a fresh site: exit 0, top-level ok, all five named checks present and ok, no key-pinned without --scope
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; out=$(node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s); rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$out" | node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const n=['state-dir-mode','site-key-mode','ledger-local-fs','ledger-verifies','isolation-tool'];const c=j.checks.map(x=>x.check);if(j.ok!==true||!j.checks.every(x=>x.ok===true)||n.some(x=>!c.includes(x))||c.includes('key-pinned'))process.exit(1)"

checks.name: world-writable state dir: exit nonzero, top-level ok false, only state-dir-mode fails
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; chmod 777 $d/s; out=$(node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$out" | node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const bad=j.checks.filter(x=>!x.ok).map(x=>x.check);if(j.ok!==false||bad.length!==1||bad[0]!=='state-dir-mode')process.exit(1)"

checks.name: group-readable site key (0644): site-key-mode fails, exit nonzero
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; chmod 644 $d/s/site/site.key; out=$(node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$out" | node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const k=j.checks.find(x=>x.check==='site-key-mode');if(j.ok!==false||!k||k.ok!==false)process.exit(1)"

checks.name: tampered ledger line: ledger-verifies fails, exit nonzero
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; printf "%s\n" '{"tampered":true}' >> $d/s/ledger/article12.jsonl; out=$(node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$out" | node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const k=j.checks.find(x=>x.check==='ledger-verifies');if(j.ok!==false||!k||k.ok!==false)process.exit(1)"

checks.name: unpinned scope: key-pinned present and fails (missing pin = fail), exit nonzero
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; out=$(node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s --scope config/aegis-pilot/reference-scope.json 2>/dev/null); rc=$?; [ $rc -ne 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$out" | node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const k=j.checks.find(x=>x.check==='key-pinned');if(!k||k.ok!==false)process.exit(1)"

checks.name: doctor is read-only: state tree byte-identical before and after (files, modes, contents)
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts init --state-dir $d/s --site-id doc-test >/dev/null || exit 1; h(){ (cd $d/s && find . -type f -o -type d | sort | xargs stat -c "%n %a %s %Y" && find . -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum); }; a=$(h); node --import tsx scripts/aegis-pilot.ts doctor --state-dir $d/s >/dev/null; b=$(h); [ "$a" = "$b" ]

checks.name: doctor suite passes with at least 6 cases
checks.run: out=$(npx vitest run src/__tests__/aegis-pilot-doctor.test.ts --reporter=json 2>/dev/null); echo "$out" | node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const j=JSON.parse(t.slice(t.indexOf('{')));if(!j.success||j.numPassedTests<6||j.numFailedTests>0||j.numTodoTests>0)process.exit(1)"
